title: Original pelican cycling SVG animation

source.request: Create a new 2D SVG animation of a pelican riding a bicycle without consulting prior artwork.

checks.detail: Standalone SVG parses as XML; 19 SMIL animation elements; no scripts or external assets.
Nine sampled pedal phases: ankle-to-foot anchor error <0.000062 SVG units; hip-to-body mismatch <0.000008 SVG units. First and last generated pose match.
Browser rendering and visual inspection at 1120, 736 and 320 CSS px; no horizontal overflow. This is browser-runtime validation, not embedded-device or physical-mechanics validation.
Safari and Firefox were not exercised.
No firmware or embedded hardware is involved.

notes: Newly drawn vector paths; no historical artwork or memory used for the drawing.
Browser host paths excluded from this public archive. No embedded physical or virtual device claim is made.
